name: mermaid-to-excalidraw-cli
description: CLI tool to convert Mermaid diagrams to Excalidraw format

scripts.compile: npm run bundle && bun build dist/cli.bundle.js --compile --outfile mer2excal
scripts.compile:all: npm run bundle && bun build dist/cli.bundle.js --compile --target=bun-darwin-arm64 --outfile mer2excal-darwin-arm64 && bun build dist/cli.bundle.js --compile --target=bun-darwin-x64 --outfile mer2excal-darwin-x64
